calls.statement: SELECT fiscal_period_label, min(calendar_date) s, max(calendar_date) e, count(*) n, max(is_53_week_year) w53 FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period IN (5,6) GROUP BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.quantity AS units
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND (s.store_id <> 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.quantity_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
by_sku AS (
    SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.brand, cp.category, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(n.units) AS units
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
    GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
)
SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY net_sales DESC) rk_net, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY units DESC) rk_units
FROM by_sku ORDER BY net_sales DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT 'sales' t, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) d_rl, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2026-08-28' AND '2026-10-04'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', count(*), count(DISTINCT return_line_id), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), min(return_date), max(return_date)
FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN '2026-08-31' AND '2026-09-27'

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND (s.store_id <> 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
